StandardPaymentResilience

The canonical resilience policy applied to payment provider HttpClients: 2 retries with 1s delay, 30s per-attempt timeout, 60s circuit-breaker sampling, 90s total request timeout.

public static readonly Action<HttpStandardResilienceOptions> StandardPaymentResilience
